file(GLOB eventvwr_rc_deps res/*.*)
add_rc_deps(eventvwr.rc ${eventvwr_rc_deps})

# eventvwr.exe is all Rust (eventvwr-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/eventvwr-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# eventvwr.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/eventvwr-rust/src/eventvwr/eventvwr.rs)
# evtdetctl.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/eventvwr-rust/src/eventvwr/evtdetctl.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(eventvwr_res OBJECT eventvwr.rc)
target_compile_definitions(eventvwr_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(eventvwr_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(EVENTVWR_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/pseh/libpseh.a)
if(ARCH STREQUAL "i386")
    list(APPEND EVENTVWR_REUSED ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/libchkstk.a)
endif()
if(ARCH STREQUAL "arm64")
    list(APPEND EVENTVWR_REUSED ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/libchkstk.a)
endif()
add_cargo_module(eventvwr eventvwr-cargo eventvwr.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE eventvwr-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS eventvwr_res ${EVENTVWR_REUSED})
